bullets.text: Siri's Weather Reports Need Improvement - **Apple**'s voice assistant lacks accurate weather data for locations outside California.
Nothing Phone (4a) Pro Impresses - **Nothing**'s latest smartphone offers a refreshing design and solid performance.
AirPods Max 2 and Mac Pro News - **Apple** celebrates its 50th anniversary while discontinuing the Mac Pro.
iOS 26.4 Enhances Reminders - New features in **Apple**'s Reminders app make urgent tasks easier to manage.
AirTag 2 Anti-Stalking Update - **Apple** improves AirTag's anti-stalking features with a louder alert sound.
Samsung Messages to Discontinue - **Samsung** will phase out its Messages app in July, transitioning to Google Messages.
AT&T's OneConnect Bundles Services - **AT&T** introduces a new bundle combining mobile and home internet for new customers.
